messages:
maria: Quick poll — trying out a compact 'checkpoint card' pattern for first-run setup. Each card is a micro-checklist (e.g., 'Add API key', 'Create sample project', 'Run quickstart'). Screenshot: https://figma.mock/mock123 (placeholder). What's the tradeoff vs. the current checklist modal? :thinking_face:

ben: I like the visual affordance, feels lighter than a modal. Concern: do we expose too many choices early? Could increase cognitive load. Also keyboard users: can cards be focused and activated with Enter? :keyboard:

alex: mock attached (Figma link). Cards are 3-up on desktop, 1-up on mobile. Copy variant A uses verbs: `Connect account`, `Pick a sample`, `Send a test request`. Variant B is friendlier: `Connect your account`, `Try a sample project`, `Send a quick request`. Thoughts on tone?

sara: From infra POV, each card triggers a different onboarding flow. Need to ensure eventing doesn't spam analytics — prefer a single `onboarding_checkpoint` event with a `step` property. Also blocked if we want to lazy-load sample artifacts.

julia: Did 5 users yesterday. They understood the flow but stumbled on 'Connect model' label — they expected 'Add API key' or 'Sign in'. Recommend copy change to 'Add API key' in the first card. Also users liked progress feedback when steps are auto-detected.

ben: Accessibility nits: focus ring missing in the prototype; high-contrast mode shows some text blends with the background. Also ensure `role=button` and `aria-pressed` when selected for screen readers. :eyes:

alex: noted — will update prototype: keyboard nav + focus styles + aria labels. For copy, leaning toward friendlier Variant B but will swap 'Connect model' -> 'Add API key' per Julia.

maria: Nice. One question on dismissal: should users be able to dismiss the strip forever? Suggest: dismiss until next major version or 30 days. Also add 'Remind me later' micro-interaction.

sara: For retention, adding opt-out persistent setting in profile is easier long-term than storing cookie. Will estimate engineering effort: ~1 day for opt-out flag + 2 days to wire events and lazy-load samples.

design-bot: Component guidance — use `card-list` token, set min-width 240px, include `aria-labelledby` for each card. See design system ticket #3421: https://design.internal/3421

maria: Action items: Alex -> update Figma and produce accessible states; Sara -> spike opt-out persistence; Ben -> run quick a11y check once prototype updated; Julia -> run another 5 moderated tests with the new copy. I'll sync in next Wed design sync. :calendar:
